title: The Moon Has Shrunk by About 150 Feet and It Still Shakes

scenes.text: The Moon is shrinking, and it's still shaking.
As its inside cools, the Moon has shrunk by about 150 feet.
Its crust cracks, and one piece is pushed up over another.
Spacecraft cameras have photographed over 3,500 of these cliffs.
Apollo seismometers recorded 28 shallow moonquakes, from about magnitude two to five.
The Moon is shrinking, right above your head.

description:
The Moon is shrinking, and it's still shaking.
It has shrunk by about 150 feet, leaving cliffs and moonquakes.
Had you heard of moonquakes?
first_comment: The Moon has shrunk 150 feet. What would you want to ask the Moon?
